info.name: Wallet Management System API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Wallet Management System REST API (v1).

Includes all 36 endpoints across Authentication, Users, Wallets, Transactions, and System Settings with automated token management scripts and environment variables.

variable.description: Base API URL for all requests
Sanctum Bearer token for Customer (USER role)
Sanctum Bearer token for Agent (AGENT role)
Sanctum Bearer token for Administrator (ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN role)
Restricted token with password-change ability for invited staff (Case B)
Sample User ID for path variables
Sample Wallet ID for path variables
Sample Transaction ID for path variables

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for customer PIN auth, agent PIN auth, admin 2FA OTP, token refresh, and multi-credential transitions (Cases A, B, C).

request.description: Public registration for customers. Grants 50.00 BDT bonus, sets caps, and issues user token.
Public registration for agents. Sets status to PENDING until approved by admin.
Customer login using 5-digit PIN. Protected with anti-timing attack dummy hashing.
Agent login using 5-digit PIN. Requires APPROVED agent status.
Step 1 of admin authentication: validates password and emails 6-digit OTP code.
Step 2 of admin authentication: verifies 6-digit OTP and issues admin bearer token.

item.name: Case A: Request Admin Set-PIN OTP

request.description: Case A: Admin requests an OTP sent to registered email to provision customer PIN.

item.name: Case A: Admin Set PIN with OTP

request.description: Case A: Admin verifies OTP and sets 5-digit PIN for personal account.

item.name: Case B: Accept Staff Invitation (Signed Link)

variable.description: Target User ID from invitation link

request.description: Case B: Invited user verifies temporary password via signed URL, receives temporary password-change token.
Case B: First-login mandatory password change; upgrades temporary token to full admin token.

item.name: Case C: Staff Initiate Customer PIN Reset

request.description: Case C: Support staff initiates signed PIN recovery link after manual customer identity verification.

item.name: Case C: Reset Customer PIN (Signed Link)

variable.description: Target User ID from signed recovery link

request.description: Case C: Customer sets new 5-digit PIN via secure signed recovery URL.
Dispatches 6-digit password reset OTP to admin email. Timing attack and enumeration safe.
Resets administrative password using verified OTP code.
Revokes caller current token and returns a fresh replacement.
Revokes caller current Sanctum access token.

item.name: 2. Users
item.description: User management, administrative staff provisioning, agent approval/suspension, and profile updates.

request.description: Direct registration of staff or users by an authorized administrator.
Paginated directory of all registered users, roles, statuses, and wallets.
Returns profile detail for a user. UserPolicy permits own profile or admin.
Updates name or email of the specified user.
Approves pending agent, assigns commission rate, and unlocks transactional features.
Suspends agent and revokes cash-in/cash-out/withdrawal capabilities.

item.name: Grant Admin Access / Invite Staff (Case B)

request.description: Super admin promotes existing user to admin and sends signed invitation link with temporary password.

item.name: 3. Wallets
item.description: Wallet balance checking, administrative wallet oversight, and freeze/unfreeze controls.

request.description: Retrieves authenticated user wallet balance, currency, status, and remaining transaction caps.
Administrative overview of all wallets across the system.
Administrative freeze on a wallet, blocking all debit and credit operations.
Restores an active state to a previously blocked wallet.

item.name: 4. Transactions
item.description: Financial operations (Top-Up, Transfer, Cash-In, Cash-Out, Agent Withdrawal), transaction history, and admin audit.

request.description: Customer simulates loading money into their personal wallet.
Peer-to-peer transfer between customers with PIN validation and cap checks.
Customer receives funds from agent wallet. Agent earns commission.
Customer withdraws physical cash from agent. System fee and agent commission are computed.
Approved agent withdraws balance to their bank account.
Paginated history of transactions for caller personal wallet.
Administrative ledger of all financial transactions across the platform.
Fetches detailed record of an individual transaction.

item.name: 5. System Settings
item.description: Global financial configuration for system fee rates and default agent commission rates.

request.description: Returns global fee and default commission configuration values.
Updates global transaction fee rates and commission rates.
